m.quote_history.rationale: Kalshi quote series needs only the Kalshi market-data API (mkt.kalshi_prices); PLAYER_BOX[snap] and NEWS[trade] are incidental keyword hits ('snapshot', 'trade-api') on the provenance text, not data the input reads.

m.volume_oi.rationale: Volume/open interest is Kalshi API market data (mkt.kalshi_prices); NEWS[trade] matched the word 'trade' in the market-data description, no news/transactions feed is read.

m.ladder_structure.rationale: Ladder consistency is computed from the Kalshi strike ladder prices (mkt.kalshi_prices); PLAYER_BOX[stat] is a spurious hit, no player box data is used.

m.rules_text.rationale: Versioned rule/settlement wording is Kalshi rules text (mkt.kalshi_rules) plus NCAA rules reference; PLAYER_BOX[snap] is a spurious hit on 'snapshot'. Kalshi wording vintages are not archived free, so history is prospective.

m.lifecycle.rationale: Open/close/halt/postponement lifecycle comes from Kalshi market metadata (mkt.kalshi_prices/rules); AVAIL[status], PLAYER_BOX[minutes], TEAM_BOX[record] and NEWS are spurious keyword hits (status, minutes, record, news in generic text).

m.trade_tape.rationale: Executed-trade tape is Kalshi trade API data (mkt.kalshi_prices); NEWS[trades] is a spurious match on the word 'trades', no news feed is needed.

cbb.market_calibration_bias.rationale: Price-bucket miscalibration uses Kalshi prices vs settled outcomes (mkt.kalshi_prices + games results); TEAM_BOX[team] was an incidental hit. Benchmark only.

cbb.implied_team_totals.rationale: Market-implied points come from sportsbook spread/total with capture times (mkt.external_odds, PAID_ONLY history) plus rating-implied points; PLAYER_BOX[snap] is spurious. Benchmark-only and depends on cbb.ratings.

cbb.adj_off.rationale: games_espn holds only scores/half scores/venue; points per 100 possessions needs FGA, FTA, OREB, TO per team-game (cbb.box_player or Torvik team tables). AVAIL[availab] and EVENT[garbage] are optional refinements in the measurement, not a requirement; computed status rests on scores-only proxy.

cbb.adj_def.rationale: Defensive efficiency per 100 possessions needs opponent FGA/FTA/OREB/TO from box data (box_player/Torvik); the scoreboard archive only has points. SCHEME[shot quality] and AVAIL are optional blend terms ('where available'), not required raw data.

cbb.ratings.rationale: Derived blend: free ratings (Torvik, own ridge) plus a market-implied benchmark component built from de-vigged closing spreads (mkt.external_odds, paid history). Depends on cbb.ratings_fundamentals; Torvik is FREE_BLOCKED_FROM_RUNNER so computed status is only a own-ridge proxy.
cbb.ratings.notes: market-implied rating_mkt component is benchmark-only; rating_free is market-free

cbb.preseason_prior.rationale: Prior needs prior-season player minutes (returning production, cbb.box_player, unconfirmed), recruiting/portal composites (FINAL_ONLY, no vintages) and coaching changes (staff history); cannot be COMPUTED_PROXY from scores. Built from cbb.recruit_exp and cbb.ratings.

cbb.rating_uncertainty.rationale: Derived: posterior uncertainty and schedule connectivity are outputs of the rating model, so capped by cbb.ratings; connectivity itself only needs the games_espn schedule graph.

cbb.in_season_improvement.rationale: Trajectory needs player minutes/rotation settling (cbb.box_player, not collected) and roster age/class (recruiting data); LINEUP[lineup] mapping to shot_tracking_scheme is wrong, and scores-only data cannot show rotation settling. Builds on cbb.ratings.

cbb.lineup_adj_rating.rationale: Derived from team rating and player impact scaled by tonight's availability: depends on cbb.ratings, cbb.player_impact and cbb.injuries (pregame availability vintages are prospective only).

cbb.player_impact.rationale: Derived BPM/RAPM-style value: built from player box lines, on/off lineup net ratings (cbb.lineups) and team ratings; list upstream so the blocked lineup data caps it.

cbb.four_factors.rationale: eFG, TO, ORB, FT rate require team FGM/3PM/FGA/TO/OREB/FTA per game; games_espn (the mapped TEAM_BOX) has only scores, so box data (cbb.box_player or Torvik) is needed.

cbb.tempo.rationale: Possessions need FGA, FTA, OREB, TO; the scoreboard only has points, so a scores-only proxy is not tempo. Needs cbb.box_player or Torvik tempo; PLAYER_BOX[minutes] is not required.

cbb.pace_mismatch.rationale: Derived from adjusted tempo (cbb.tempo) and possession variance; possessions need team box lines (cbb.box_player/Torvik), not scoreboard scores.

cbb.size_rebounding.rationale: AVAIL[availab] is spurious (measurement has no availability term). Needs ORB%/DRB%, block rate and height (player/team tables: box_player or Torvik); rim FG% allowed needs shot locations (partial only via hoop-math).

cbb.venue.rationale: WEATHER_OBS[altitude] is wrong: altitude comes from env.venue_geo (venue coordinates/altitude), not observed weather (env.weather_observed is blocked and not relevant to indoor arenas).

cbb.neutral_site.rationale: COMPUTED_FULL is overclaimed: travel distance to the neutral site needs campus and arena coordinates (env.venue_geo, FREE_UNPROBED, hand-curated), not in hand; PLAYER_BOX[prop] is a spurious match.

cbb.rest_travel.rationale: Travel distance needs team/venue coordinates (env.venue_geo, unprobed) on top of the games_espn schedule; PLAYER_BOX[minutes] is not needed for rest/travel.

cbb.schedule_spot.rationale: Lookahead/letdown depend on the next/previous opponents' strength (cbb.ratings) and rest (cbb.rest_travel); rivalry flags and exam breaks are not in games_espn so only partly computed from margins.

cbb.conf_tourney_fatigue.rationale: AVAIL[status] is spurious (fatigue/format study uses as-played minutes and schedule). Needs player minutes (box_player), neutral venue and conference tournament format; not COLLECT_PROSPECTIVE.

cbb.motivation.rationale: Stakes are derived from standings and bubble position: depends on cbb.conference_standings_sim and cbb.resume_metrics; EVENT[leverage] is a spurious in-game keyword hit.

cbb.ot_model.rationale: Needs model expected margin/total (cbb.ratings, cbb.tempo); catalog raw_data also uses closing spread as benchmark, so market component is benchmark-only.

cbb.score_resid.rationale: Raw_data needs model expected margin/total (cbb.ratings, cbb.tempo) and closing spread/total benchmark; EXCLUDED status stands but list upstream inputs. Half scores are in games_espn.

cbb.blowout_garbage.rationale: COMPUTED_PARTIAL rests on final margins only; bench-clearing needs player minutes and score-by-clock play-by-play (cbb.box_player, unconfirmed). Builds on cbb.ratings for pregame margin expectation.

cbb.fouls_officials.rationale: OFFICIALS mapped to cbb.shot_tracking_scheme, which has no referee data; no registry dataset holds NCAA crew assignments (assigned pregame by conference, not archived). AVAIL[availab] spurious.

cbb.officials_crew.rationale: OFFICIALS mapped to cbb.shot_tracking_scheme, which has no referee data; crew assignments and per-ref foul tendencies are not in any registry dataset. AVAIL[availab] spurious.

cbb.injuries.rationale: SCHEME[formation] is a spurious hit: 'information' in the label contains 'formation'. Real needs are availability vintages (cbb.availability_snapshots, prospective capture only) and timestamped news, so status is COLLECT_PROSPECTIVE not BLOCKED.

cbb.starters.rationale: LINEUP mapped to cbb.shot_tracking_scheme (no lineup data). As-played starter flags are in box scores (cbb.box_player) but pregame confirmed starters are only capturable prospectively via cbb.availability_snapshots; EVENT[per play] spurious.

cbb.roster_minutes.rationale: LINEUP[minutes distribution] is spurious: per-player minutes come from box scores (cbb.box_player); transfer portal from cbb.recruiting_portal (final-only). No lineup stint data needed.

cbb.player_minutes.rationale: Derived projection: depends on cbb.injuries, cbb.starters, cbb.player_foul, cbb.blowout_garbage and cbb.tempo; capped by availability vintages.

cbb.player_shooting_regression.rationale: AVAIL[availab] spurious: the measurement is Beta-binomial shrinkage of 3P/FG/FT percentages with career priors; needs only player box/PBP history (cbb.box_player).

cbb.player_three_volume.rationale: 'Catch-and-shoot share' is a play-type/tracking quantity not in box scores or ESPN PBP; only partial via hoop-math/Synergy (cbb.shot_tracking_scheme, NO_FREE_SOURCE). 3PA rate alone is box data.

cbb.bracket_sim.rationale: Simulation: depends on cbb.ratings, tournament field/seeding rules (cbb.tournament_field_format), seed model (cbb.committee_seed_model) and tiebreak rules; not a plain data input.

cbb.resume_metrics.rationale: NET is NCAA's own ranking: RATINGS_EXT[net rank] mapped to Torvik is wrong (cbb.net_bracket holds NET/quadrants/team sheets). Daily NET snapshots must be captured, history via Wayback only; WAB/SOR also need cbb.ratings.

cbb.committee_seed_model.rationale: Derived: seed-line model built from resume metrics and ratings; bracketology consensus is cbb.net_bracket (history only via Wayback). Depends on cbb.resume_metrics and cbb.ratings; needs historical seeds (tourney history).

cbb.conference_standings_sim.rationale: Simulation: depends on cbb.ratings and tiebreak/seeding rules (cbb.conf_tiebreak_seeding_rules); remaining schedule must be refreshed beyond the games_espn archive end (2026-04-07).

cbb.title_path.rationale: DATA_IN_HAND is wrong: bracket path and region strength need bracket structure/seeds (cbb.net_bracket, rules) and a simulation (cbb.bracket_sim); games_espn alone only gives results.

cbb.single_game_variance.rationale: Team-style variance needs tempo and 3PA rates from box data (TEAM_BOX games_espn lacks 3PA/possessions); built on cbb.tempo and cbb.three_pt_dist.

cbb.seed_upset_priors.rationale: DATA_IN_HAND is wrong: base rates need seed-by-round results over many tournaments; games_espn covers 2021-2026 only and its ranks are retrieval-time values with no seed field. Needs a tournament-history dataset (Sports-Reference).

cbb.sos_remaining.rationale: Derived: remaining schedule strength is built on cbb.ratings plus the future schedule (games_espn archive ends 2026-04-07 so the current schedule must be pulled).

cbb.popularity_bias.rationale: Compares Kalshi price/sportsbook prices to fundamentals (raw_data): market-derived benchmark input, not computable market-free; status should be EXCLUDED_BENCHMARK_ONLY.

cbb.unrated_opponent_prior.rationale: Derived: tier and conference mean ratings come from cbb.ratings/cbb.conf_strength; D3/D1 buy-game history needs non-D1 results absent from the D1 scoreboard archive, so DATA_IN_HAND overclaims.

cbb.coach_blowout_substitution_rate.rationale: Needs coach by team-season (coaching staff history, absent from the mapped datasets) plus score-and-clock PBP and minutes; builds on cbb.blowout_garbage.

cbb.margin_regime_mixture.rationale: DATA_IN_HAND overclaims: raw_data needs model expected margins, OT frequency and coach_decay, i.e. cbb.ratings, cbb.ot_model and cbb.coach_blowout_substitution_rate.

cbb.margin_total_covariance.rationale: Raw_data uses model expected margin and total plus tempo terciles: derived from cbb.ratings and cbb.tempo (tempo needs box data).

cbb.point_in_time_rating_snapshot.rationale: Own daily snapshots of adj_off, adj_def, tempo for all D1 teams: derived from those inputs; history only reconstructible from Torvik time-machine (blocked from runner). PLAYER_BOX[snap] is spurious on 'snapshot'.

cbb.ratings_fundamentals.rationale: Ensemble: derived from cbb.adj_off/adj_def, preseason prior (returning minutes) and Torvik snapshots; PLAYER_BOX[snap] is spurious, returning-minutes need box_player.

cbb.possession_length_profile.rationale: Average possession length needs PBP clock times; transition share is a play-type quantity (hoop-math partial only), not in box or ESPN PBP.

cbb.ot_period_tie_chain.rationale: Derived: OT reach distribution uses margin distributions from cbb.ot_model/cbb.tempo; possessions need box data.

cbb.total_variance_by_style.rationale: Raw_data lists model expected total, possessions, 3PA share, FT rate: built on cbb.ratings, cbb.tempo, cbb.three_pt_dist, which need box data not in scoreboard.

cbb.league_scoring_baseline_drift.rationale: NEWS[announce] is spurious/too pessimistic: NCAA rules-committee announcement dates are static public reference (RULES), not live vintages; needs league points and possessions by date (box data) over multiple seasons.

cbb.pace_elasticity_to_opponent.rationale: Raw_data uses team adjusted tempo and league mean tempo: derived from cbb.tempo.

cbb.team_points_margin_coupling.rationale: DATA_IN_HAND overclaims: needs expected margins from cbb.ratings and a favorite/underdog role (spread bucket is market-derived); not final scores alone.

cbb.coach_early_foul_bench_rule.rationale: Raw_data needs coach by team-season (coaching staff history, missing from the mapped needs) plus foul/substitution PBP events with clock and starter flags.

cbb.half_tie_probability.rationale: Raw_data uses expected margin and first-half possessions: derived from cbb.ratings and cbb.tempo (half scores themselves are in games_espn).

cbb.halftime_state_adjustment.rationale: Live halftime state (not pregame) uses pregame expected margin: depends on cbb.ratings and cbb.half_split; halftime foul and injury flags need live PBP.

cbb.second_half_pregame_expectation.rationale: Derived from expected total/first-half expectation and late-foul/OT terms: depends on cbb.ratings, cbb.tempo, cbb.half_split, cbb.late_game_foul_script, cbb.ot_model.

cbb.minutes_scenario_mixture.rationale: Raw_data needs coach identity (coaching staff history) and a back-to-back flag; scenario mixture builds on cbb.player_minutes, cbb.player_foul, cbb.blowout_garbage, cbb.rest_travel.

cbb.player_shot_mix_xpps.rationale: Raw_data is attempts and makes by shot zone with opponent zone rates: shot-location splits are not in box scores; registry maps only partial hoop-math to cbb.shot_tracking_scheme (NO_FREE_SOURCE), same treatment as cbb.shot_zones.

cbb.transfer_role_cold_start_prior.rationale: AVAIL[availab] spurious (no pregame availability in raw_data). Needs previous-season player stats from other schools, recruiting composites and portal movement (cbb.recruiting_portal, FINAL_ONLY, no vintages) so pit is leaky.

cbb.role_stable_effective_sample.rationale: AVAIL[availab] spurious: raw_data is as-played minutes, starter flags and teammate availability per game, all box-score history (cbb.box_player), not pregame vintages.

cbb.rebound_competition_on_floor.rationale: Derived from lineup scenarios and availability probabilities: depends on cbb.injuries and cbb.player_minutes; LINEUP data stays blocked.

cbb.miss_location_mix.rationale: Raw_data is FGA/FGM by zone and rebounds by miss location: shot-location data not in box scores (only partial hoop-math); needs shot-tracking/scheme dataset.

cbb.assist_conversion_chain.rationale: Raw_data needs team FGA/FGM by zone with assisted flag; shot zones are not in box scores (cbb.shot_tracking_scheme, partial only).

cbb.crash_vs_get_back_scheme.rationale: Raw_data needs opponent transition points per 100 via PBP classification: transition is a scheme/play-type quantity (cbb.shot_tracking_scheme partial).

cbb.three_makes_compound_distribution.rationale: Compound distribution uses minutes mixture and team pace: built on cbb.player_minutes, cbb.tempo and cbb.player_three_volume.

cbb.strength_evolution_to_march.rationale: PLAYER_BOX[snap] spurious; needs weekly past-season rating snapshots (Torvik time machine, blocked from runner), returning minutes and roster age; derived from cbb.ratings and cbb.preseason_prior.

cbb.pod_site_proximity.rationale: Needs campus and arena coordinates (env.venue_geo) and historical pod site assignments by seed/round (tournament history), absent from the draft's needs; derived from cbb.bracket_sim and cbb.ratings.

cbb.two_way_balance_profile.rationale: Raw_data uses pre-tournament off/def ranks (cbb.adj_off, cbb.adj_def) and tournament advancement outcomes across seasons (tournament history; games_espn has only 5 seasons).

cbb.committee_ordinal_seed_model.rationale: PLAYER_BOX[snap] spurious. Needs Selection Sunday team sheets (NET, quadrants, WAB, SOR: cbb.net_bracket, Wayback history) and final seeds (tournament history); derived from cbb.resume_metrics and cbb.ratings_fundamentals.

cbb.top_n_tie_inclusive_cutoff.rationale: DATA_IN_HAND overclaims: raw_data is simulation draws of conference win totals, derived from cbb.conference_standings_sim and cbb.ratings.

cbb.strength_uncertainty_game_correlatio.rationale: PLAYER_BOX[share] spurious. Needs historical rating-based win totals (Torvik history) and roster-change flags (recruiting/portal); built on cbb.ratings and cbb.rating_uncertainty.

cbb.joint_advancement_dependence.rationale: Simulation output: depends on cbb.bracket_sim, cbb.ratings and cbb.tournament_field_format; MARKET_RULES[void] is a spurious hit on 'avoidance'.

cbb.clinch_and_elimination_effort_shift.rationale: DATA_IN_HAND overclaims: raw_data uses conference standings simulation output and rating-implied expected margins (cbb.conference_standings_sim, cbb.ratings).

cbb.remaining_game_resume_leverage.rationale: EVENT[leverage] is a spurious in-game keyword; real inputs are NET value index/quadrant data (cbb.net_bracket) and WAB, built on cbb.resume_metrics and cbb.ratings.

cbb.committee_metric_revealed_weights.rationale: Needs NET and team-sheet metrics on Selection Sunday 2019-2026 (cbb.net_bracket, not Torvik) and final seeds (tournament history); games_espn only covers 2021-2026.

cbb.recency_weighting_in_seeding.rationale: DATA_IN_HAND overclaims: needs historical final seeds (not in games_espn, 5 seasons only) and last-10 records; builds on cbb.committee_ordinal_seed_model.

cbb.ap_voter_ballot_panel.rationale: Needs individual AP ballots (voter id, ranks 1-25); xx.awards_results is not for AP ballots (mapped AWARDS[ballot]) and notes ballot-level only for some awards. AP publishes ballots (apnews) but no registry dataset holds them.

cbb.final_ap_rank_mapping.rationale: Needs tournament round reached and seeds by season (tournament history), not in games_espn (5 seasons) alongside AP poll history (cbb.polls).

cbb.kenpom_rank_projection.rationale: Needs daily KenPom AdjO/AdjD/tempo/rank snapshots (KenPom is PAID_ONLY; Torvik is only an analog). PROJECTIONS[projection] is spurious (own model projection, not external vintages). Derived from cbb.adj_off, cbb.adj_def, cbb.tempo.

cbb.award_selection_model.rationale: Needs 1990-2026 Final Four box scores and MOP winners (long history; cbb.box_player has no confirmed history) and team success dependence (cbb.bracket_sim).

cbb.stat_leader_race_model.rationale: PROJECTIONS[projection] is spurious (refers to bracket_sim games projection). Derived from cbb.bracket_sim, availability probabilities (cbb.injuries), cbb.player_usage and cbb.player_minutes.

cbb.d3_team_rating.rationale: Division III results are not in games_espn (D1 scoreboard archive, 31,039 games); needs a D3 results dataset (NCAA stats).

cbb.round_max_team_score.rationale: Simulation: depends on cbb.bracket_sim and team totals from cbb.adj_off/adj_def/tempo (box-based).

cbb.secondary_postseason_field_model.rationale: Raw_data names KenPom conference ratings (Selection-Sunday vintage) plus daily vintages of NET, KPI, SOR, BPI, Torvik, WAB: KenPom is PAID_ONLY and daily rank vintages are not archived free.

cbb.wcbb_title_probability.rationale: Women's results/NET are not in cbb.games_espn (men's scoreboard); CONTRACTS[contract] spurious ('combo contracts' are Kalshi contracts). Needs a women's results dataset.

cbb.in_season_event_format.rationale: Needs event rosters, brackets and tiebreak rules published by organizers (reference documents), not player box data; PLAYER_BOX spurious. Uses cbb.ratings with posterior sd.

cbb.co_champion_expected_share.rationale: PLAYER_BOX[share] is spurious (1/N share). Derived from cbb.conference_standings_sim and tie policy in conference rules.

cbb.conf_tiebreak_seeding_rules.rationale: NET rank date rules refer to NCAA NET (cbb.net_bracket), not Torvik; tiebreak order is reference text.

cbb.bracket_seed_statistic_sim.rationale: DATA_IN_HAND overclaims: raw_data needs bracket structure, win-probability model outputs and historical seed-by-round results; derived from cbb.bracket_sim and cbb.seed_upset_priors (tournament history absent).

cbb.coach_award_profile.rationale: Derived from preseason expectation and season simulation: depends on cbb.preseason_prior, cbb.ratings and cbb.conference_standings_sim; preseason rating vintages are prospective.

cbb.kenpom_adjem_gap_density.rationale: Raw_data is the daily KenPom AdjEM table with timestamps; KenPom is PAID_ONLY and Torvik only an analog (contract settles on KenPom). PLAYER_BOX[target] is spurious.

cbb.kenpom_game_update_sensitivity.rationale: Raw_data is KenPom daily rating snapshot pairs (paid); Torvik cannot supply KenPom's own updates; PLAYER_BOX[snap] is spurious.

cbb.kenpom_snapshot_timing_rules.rationale: Needs timestamped captures of the KenPom page (paid) after Selection Sunday and refresh times; PLAYER_BOX[snap] spurious.

cbb.kenpom_prior_drift.rationale: Raw_data is daily KenPom snapshots over 5 seasons (paid; Torvik time-machine only an analog); PLAYER_BOX[snap] spurious; depends on cbb.preseason_prior.

cbb.race_n_threshold_scaling.rationale: Raw_data uses AdjO/AdjD for both teams: derived from cbb.adj_off and cbb.adj_def; PBP time-to-N needs cbb.box_player.

cbb.team_postseason_games_projection.rationale: Simulation: raw_data lists bracket_sim, conference standings sim, auto-bid structure and NIT/Crown rules as inputs.

cbb.coach_candidate_track_record.rationale: Raw_data is coach tenures by team-season, end-of-season adjusted margin, tournament results and athletic budget: historical/static, so NEWS[coach candidate] is not the main need; missing coaching history and finance (cbb.coaching_finance, EADA).

cbb.candidate_program_ties.rationale: Needs coach/AD biographies and staff history by year (no registry dataset; manual coding) plus timestamped agent reports.

cbb.program_hiring_resources.rationale: VENUE[venue] spurious. Needs salary/buyout/revenue data (cbb.coaching_finance, vintages not preserved) and reported offers (timestamped news, prospective).

cbb.candidate_availability_calendar.rationale: Derived: raw_data uses bracket_sim elimination date, vacancy date and buyout step-downs: depends on cbb.bracket_sim, cbb.coach_vacancy_search_state, cbb.program_hiring_resources.

cbb.coach_hire_field_residual.rationale: Derived from report ledger and departure hazard; EVENT[hazard] is statistical, not in-game: depends on cbb.coaching_search_report_ledger and cbb.incumbent_coach_departure_hazard.

cbb.interim_coach_season_audition.rationale: DATA_IN_HAND overclaims: needs interim coach identity/tenure and named-permanent history (no coaching dataset), plus expected margins from cbb.ratings/cbb.preseason_prior.

cbb.incumbent_coach_departure_hazard.rationale: EVENT[hazard] is statistical. Needs coach age/tenure history, contract years remaining (vintages not preserved), and health/retirement reports; builds on cbb.ratings and cbb.preseason_prior.

cbb.endgame_tie_decision_policy.rationale: SCHEME[shot type] is spurious: raw_data shot type is 2pt/3pt/foul from PBP text, not a play-type scheme. Needs end-of-game PBP and coach by team-season (coaching history).

cbb.ot_foul_carryover_depletion.rationale: LINEUP[lineup] is spurious: raw_data is player foul counts and team foul state at end of regulation (PBP/box), not lineup stints.

cbb.player_game_exposure_tournament.rationale: Derived: field entry x team survival x availability: depends on cbb.bracket_sim, cbb.injuries and cbb.star_injury_risk.

cbb.milestone_union_aggregation.rationale: Raw_data is bracket simulation draws, per-game stat models and a minutes model: depends on cbb.bracket_sim, cbb.stat_dist, cbb.player_minutes, cbb.triple_double_joint_propensity.

cbb.elimination_game_star_minutes.rationale: LINEUP[minutes distribution] is spurious: raw_data is tournament player box-score minutes and usage ranks (cbb.box_player), no lineup stints.

cbb.concurrent_vacancy_competition.rationale: VENUE[capacity] spurious ('offer capacity'). Needs vacancy/hire dates and dated candidate reports (cbb.coaching_search_report_ledger) plus school finance and tournament history.

new_datasets.title: NCAA tournament seeds, rounds, results and site assignments by season (Sports-Reference)
new_datasets.missingness: seed-by-round history is a static table; not in games_espn (2021-2026 only)

new_datasets.title: Head coach by team-season, tenures, interim/permanent status and staff history
new_datasets.missingness: coach identity is not in games_espn; biographies/staff history need manual coding

new_datasets.missingness: no known free structured archive; assignments are not preserved pregame

new_datasets.missingness: games_espn is a D1 scoreboard archive; D3 coverage unverified

registry_objections.objection: Described as scores, half scores, venue, neutral flag, attendance and retrieval-time ranks: no FGA/FTA/TO/OREB or possession fields, so rules.py M['CBB']['TEAM_BOX'] must not treat it as satisfying efficiency/tempo/four-factors needs; those require box_player or Torvik.

Mapped in rules.py M for LINEUP, TRACKING, SCHEME and OFFICIALS, but its title covers shot-location splits, lineups and play types only; it contains no referee data (OFFICIALS), and shot zones/transition share are its only real SCHEME content.
